prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — Wen Yang of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a sunny ranch — a weathered wooden fence, hay bales and horses grazing in the distance
Outfit: a club outfit — a liquid-metallic cowl-neck slip mini dress with thin straps and strappy heels — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: attentive, steady eyes, mouth closed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most the one small accessory below.

Her legend — peerless solo courage, a steel whip-sword — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Accessory: off duty she carries no weapon or armour — her signature weapon (a steel whip-sword) appears only as a bag charm modelled on its shape and colours, a few centimetres long, clearly jewellery.

Light: the place's own light, with a strong soft rim light tracing her hair and shoulders, glossy highlights on skin and jewellery and drifting light particles — a luxurious promotional glow.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: User selected world 4/4/4 and authorized normal main push; preserve successful images.

observations: 1024x1536; same recognizable face, black hair and skin as selected world image.
No weapon, logo or watermark. Visible limbs and fingers show no obvious count defect.
Close-up crop extends below the shoulders; horses appear in ranch background as the place description requests, conflicting with global no-animal rule.
